notes.title: About an upcoming update
notes.content: [p]I have been working on a 5-year anniversary update for Dr. Atominus. It's coming a bit late, but here is a sneak peak to the update and also some other important info.[/p][p][/p][h2]A lot of polishing and quality of life updates[/h2][p]The update will include many small improvements to the game, like improved knockback, hard difficulty and remastered sound. There are also performance improvements and bug fixes.[/p][p]Along with the update, native Linux support will be coming to Steam. It already works well with proton, but native support has some advantages, like faster startup and easier to navigate game files.[/p][p][/p][h2]Saving system change and backwards compatibility[/h2][p]Recently Dr. Atominus became available for Playstation 4. A new efficient save system was added for this and it will be on the PC version too. Because of this, old save files will not be compatible with the updated game. That is why I'm telling about the update in advance, so in case you are just playing through the game, you might want to disable updates temporarily. The update will probably be coming either next week or the week after that.[/p][p][/p][p]I will tell more details about the update when it comes.[/p][p][/p][p]Edit: The update will be coming August 11.[/p]

notes.title: My new game coming soon: Strategy game but with a penguin who has a sword
notes.content:
It's been about one and half years since I released my last game, and now I can finally announce my next game!

[h1]Strategy game but with a penguin who has a sword[/h1]

It's a relaxing strategy / tactics rougelite game with lofi hiphop music. And there is a penguin. <(")

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37712971/8934dd1e8127a028c5e9c22982cc2dad6fd44619.gif[/img]

[b]Some features[/b]
[list]
[*] Turn-based strategy
[*] Both hand-designed and infinite randomized rooms
[*] Good lofi hiphop music
[*] The penguin can be customized :)
[*] Ideal to play while listening to something
[/list]

Maybe add it to your wishlist?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423780/

notes.title: Update Version 2.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Dr. Atominus Version 2.3.0[/h2]

Dr. Atominus was just updated! In this update, some graphics were improved and there were also some other small improvements.


[h3]Improved some graphics[/h3]

The sprites / images of 2 bosses have been improved a little. First, the infamously ugly spider.

Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/d56ce57befafa3302086a3f1cf2bcf32add17ad7.png[/img]

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/d6034f511eb1210ecce02eab0ceeb62575b7b6fe.png[/img]

Also, the true last boss. But I’m not putting the image here because of spoilers.


[h3]Other improvements[/h3]
[list][*] In the settings, when changing the language, it will now always show the word "language" in English too, so the option is easier to find when accidentally changing the language
[*] The game engine and other software was updated. Thanks to that, the download size of the game is a little smaller. The file size never was large, but even a little helps people with not much free space.
[/list]


That’s all. I hope this update will improve the overall quality of the game. :)

notes.title: Dr. Atominus epilogue released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A short epilogue for Dr. Atominus has been released today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/a307ee43757d0a082e7d7a8161af13adf98861cb.png[/img]

[h3]About the epilogue[/h3]

Dr. Atominus has 3 different endings, and this epilogue takes place after the true ending. How is the life of Dr. Atominus, the AI and atom after 3 years? Find out in this small addition to the story!

The epilogue is a free update. It is short (~5-10 minutes), but it gives a better conclusion to the game.

[h1]Dr. Atominus version 1.2.0[/h1]

Hello! Dr. Atominus has been updated to version 1.2.0. Spanish translation was added, many bugs were fixed and the game overall has been improved.


[h2]In detail, the changes are here:[/h2]
[b]
Features[/b]

notes.title: Launch date and other news
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this update I'll tell you the launch date of Dr. Atominus. Also I'll talk about some recent improvements in the game. Also there is a new trailer.

[h2]LAUNCH DATE IS SET[/h2]
[h3]Dr. Atominus will launch 22.7.2020![/h3] Only three weeks from now!


[h2]NEW TRAILER[/h2]
The game has changed a lot and a new trailer was needed. The existing trailer focused on the story, but this one focuses more on the gameplay. Here it is:
[previewyoutube=km-87JSpdOk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]RECENT IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[b]Map[/b]
A map was added to the game. It doesn't show your location, but it's very helpful to find new places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/f64721af2d372f6fb2ab52658e748c478a7e68ea.gif[/img]

[b]UI[/b]
The User Interface has been improved. Blue coins were removed, because they didn't have any use. Also, now coins are health. The Atom uses energy from them to keep alive. Also, I made the pause menu a little better looking.


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
I have also fixed dozens of bugs in the past weeks. Some of them were really weird.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/8588bcd735e437678b158f06ba5f1299dfc32a9b.gif[/img]


That's all! Be sure to [u]wishlist the game[/u]! And you can also follow my developer page here.
Dr. Atominus Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294750/Dr_Atominus/
My Steam publisher page: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/pikku-a

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37633421/b5f1b09e6c0fb7a58690a679ec2f7f0b8c8d2925.gif[/img]

Even Dr. Atominus is excited that his game will be soon available...
